朝鮮國勢調査報告 1930 全鮮編 結果表

Chōsen kokusei chōsa hōkoku, Shōwa 5-nen, zensen-hen dai 1-kan kekkahyō (Report of the 1930 Census of Korea, Whole Country, vol. 1: Result Tables), as of 1 October 1930
朝鮮總督府, 京城, 1932–35

All 66 tables and the occupational classification are transcribed (about 211,000 figure cells), with one of the nine charts that prints its figures; the other charts print no figures. Tables printed in panels (縱/橫: blocks of occupation rows × groups of area columns) are given one part per row block with both column groups joined. Each spread was read once by a Claude Sonnet agent from tight crops; where a digit was blurred in the NDL scan (bold 3, 8 and 9 look alike), the agent read it from the second copy of the same edition on Commons and noted it. 18 cells could not be read in either copy and are marked [?]. Printed totals were re-added; those that do not add up are kept as printed and noted, and where a digit was ambiguous only between 3 and 8 and exactly one reading made a printed total reconcile, that reading is used and noted.
